## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows naming convention: `<type>/<short-description>`

- [ ] No debug code, print statements, or hard-coded paths
- [ ] NAMESPACE regenerated if imports/exports changed (`devtools::document()`)
- [ ] `R/sysdata.rda` regenerated from `data-raw/` if team data changed
